source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)\n    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    # Fill between the outermost non-background cells in each row and column.\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]\n        if len(marks) >= 2:\n            for c in range(marks[0] + 1, marks[-1]):\n                if out[r][c] == background:\n                    out[r][c] = 3\n    for c in range(w):\n        marks = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != background]\n        if len(marks) >= 2:\n            for r in range(marks[0] + 1, marks[-1]):\n                if out[r][c] == background:\n                    out[r][c] = 3\n    return out\n'''
